title: Consultor SAP HCM Sênior (Time & Folha) com conhecimento em EHS
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Sobre a oportunidade:


Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) SAP HCM Sênior , com sólida experiência em Time Management e Folha de Pagamento , e conhecimento em EHS (Environment, Health and Safety) para atuar em projeto estratégico de SAP. O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir a integração entre os módulos de RH e segurança do trabalho, contribuindo para a eficiência e conformidade dos processos.


Local: 100% remoto


Responsabilidades:

  • Parametrizar e manter os módulos SAP HCM – Time Management e Payroll ;
  • Atuar em integrações entre HCM e EHS , assegurando a correta gestão de dados de colaboradores e saúde ocupacional;
  • Apoiar o time técnico e funcional na resolução de incidentes e melhorias;
  • Elaborar documentação funcional , testes e suporte às áreas usuárias;
  • Colaborar com diferentes áreas do negócio, garantindo alinhamento das soluções às práticas corporativas;
  • Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento e definição de escopo junto à equipe de projeto.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida (mínimo 10 anos ) em SAP EHS ;
  • Conhecimento prático em SAP HCM (Time Management e Payroll) ;
  • Vivência com projetos SAP de médio e grande porte;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% remota.


Desejável:

  • Conhecimento no setor público e/ou setor de águas e saneamento ;
  • Experiência em ambientes complexos e regulados;
  • Noções de processos de segurança e compliance.


Diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em SAP Concur .


Benefícios:

✓ Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

✓ Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos

✓ Plano odontológico

✓ Programa de remuneração variável

✓ Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade

✓ Wellhub (Gympass)

✓ Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos

✓ Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional

✓ Seguro de vida

✓ Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)

✓ Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

✓ Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)

✓ Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

✓ Programa de treinamentos internos e externos

✓ Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

✓ Terapia online

✓ Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)

✓ Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro

✓ Day off no seu aniversário

✓ Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)

✓ Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna)

✓ Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa)

✓ Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento)



Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Essa é uma oportunidade também para vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.


Aviso de privacidade:

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos. Caso haja alguma dúvida em relação à privacidade dos dados ou qualquer aspecto relacionado ao tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal: Acesse o nosso aviso de privacidade para saber mais sobre o tratamento de dados pessoais realizado pela Atos.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Analista de Benefícios e Remuneração Jr
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.


Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.


Descrição Breve do Cargo:

  • Promover a gestão dos benefícios de seguro de vida, planos de saúde, empréstimo consignado e veículos, controlar os pagamentos dos benefícios, Seguros de vida e planos de saúde, odontológico, empréstimos consignados e veículos,
  • Orientar colaboradores na concessão de empréstimo consignado,
  • Realizar o processo de inclusão e exclusão dos benefícios de plano de saúde, odontológico e empréstimo consignado no sistema da empresa,
  • Prestar informações e orientações a todos os colaboradores sobre os benefícios de saúde, empréstimo consignado e seguro de vida, montar processos em casos de sinistros,
  • controlar processos de assistência médica, executar outras atividades correlatas conforme orientação superior.
  • Executar demais atividades, conforme solicitação do gestor imediato


Instrução:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Contabilidade, Recursos Humanos ou áreas afins


Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (ETL) SR


Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Migração de Dados OnPrem para Google Cloud Platform (GCP) no setor financeiro. Esse profissional será responsável pela construção, otimização e orquestração de pipelines de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, eficiência e governança durante o processo de migração.


Descrição do Cargo:

O Engenheiro de Dados GCP Sênior será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, etc.). Além disso, atuará com ferramentas de ETL, preferencialmente Informatica PowerCenter ou soluções similares, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, assegurando que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados, assegurando boas práticas de versionamento, performance e reutilização.
  • Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.
  • Implementar e manter processos de ETL, preferencialmente utilizando Informatica PowerCenter ou ETL similar, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e governança dos dados migrados.
  • Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.
  • Analisar e reestruturar processos de ETL, facilitando a migração para a nova arquitetura de dados em GCP.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções escaláveis e sustentáveis.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Conhecimento avançado em BigQuery e estruturação de dados no Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Proficiência em SQL para manipulação e otimização de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de scripts de transformação e automação.
  • Experiência com ETL, preferencialmente Informatica PowerCenter ou ferramentas similares (Talend, DataStage, etc.).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração de dados e integração entre diferentes plataformas.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com DBT para modelagem de dados, versionamento e boas práticas de engenharia analítica.
  • Vivência no setor financeiro e familiaridade com práticas de governança de dados.


Benefícios e Diferenciais:

♂ Parceria com TotalPass para acesso a academias e atividades físicas.

Oportunidades de treinamento e cursos em tecnologias de dados.

Auxílio com certificações oficiais, com 100% de reembolso ou vouchers.

Parcerias com instituições de ensino para graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.

Contratação PJ.

Trabalho 100% remoto, atuando em cliente do segmento financeiro.

title: OPERADOR DE CALDEIRA
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nossos objetivos.


Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.


Descrição Breve do Cargo :

Operar caldeiras, efetuar a dosagem de produtos químicos nas caldeiras, monitorar o descarregamento de BPF de carretas para tanques, realizar manobras de descarregamento de óleo diesel, operar estação de tratamento de agua, realizar a movimentação de insumos para a Refinaria, operar plantas de branqueamento e desodorização, executar suas atividades conforme rotinas operacionais, atuar, sempre que necessário, nas áreas de carregamento e formulação e na Estação de Tratamento de Efluentes, executar outras atividades correlatas conforme orientação superior.



Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Segurança na Operação de Vasos de Pressão - NR 13.
  • Flexibilidade de aprendizagem.
  • Experiência como operador de Caldeira ou de Produção.
  • Interesse em aprender sobre processos industriais.
  • Informática básica/intermediária.


Nossa Empresa

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse:


#VemSerAgropalma

title: Partnership Analyst
description:
Job Description


At Pluria Global , we continue to grow at an extraordinary pace. That’s why we’re looking for a true rockstar to join our mission of redefining how people and companies work together. We provide companies and employees with a disruptive solution that enables them to work from any workspace affiliated with our network (coworking spaces, business centers, private and flexible offices, hotels, libraries, cafés), where users can find and book their workspace in just one click . Unlock potential through real connections.


Pluria is a multinational startup founded in Romania, with presence in Spain, Argentina, Peru, Mexico, Chile, Brazil, Portugal, and Colombia. Our goal is to become the global solution that supports companies on their journey to becoming flexible organizations . We operate in a market growing 215% in LatAm and 55% in Colombia .


At Pluria, we believe the true engine of progress lies in real connections : when teams feel connected, both people and companies thrive. That’s why our purpose is to create connected teams that boost engagement, innovation, and results—because better companies lead to better economies and, ultimately, a better quality of life.


‍ We achieve this by bringing together three forces:

  • A network of locations that brings offices, hubs, and flexible spaces into one accessible network.
  • Bottom-up coordination , enabling intentional encounters through bookings, invitations, and approvals.
  • Top-down intelligence , delivering actionable data so leaders can make better decisions.


This is how we unlock true performance by transforming work into a space for connection, collaboration, and shared growth .


Some numbers that back us up:

  • Global presence in over 10 countries
  • More than 1,000 workspaces worldwide
  • 20% month-over-month growth
  • A global team of 30+ people
  • 100% remote and multicultural team

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency



How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:


When submitting you'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.


We're excited to meet you!

They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency



How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:


When submitting you'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.


We're excited to meet you!

title: Senior AI Automation Engineer
description:
Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience building integrations, automations, or workflow systems
  • Strong proficiency with low-code/no-code automation platforms (n8n,AI for business automation- Tray.ai, Zapier,Make | AI Workflow Automation Software & Tools ,or similar)
  • Solid JavaScript skills -most automation logic happens in JavaScript nodes and custom functions
  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar) and prompt engineering
  • Experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, JWT)
  • Understanding of data transformation and formats (JSON, XML, CSV)
  • Ability to read API documentation, debug integration issues, and troubleshoot automation failures
  • Experience building event-driven workflows and handling asynchronous processes
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Self-motivated, disciplined, and comfortable working independently across time zones
  • Great communication skills - ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Your English is at least at the Upper-Intermediate level to communicate with our teams
  • Preferred Skills/Abilities
  • Experience building AI agents or multi-step LLM workflows (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom implementations)
  • Python scripting for data processing, API integration, or ETL workflows
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools or iPaaS platforms (Temporal, Workato, MuleSoft)
  • Understanding of vector databases and semantic search for RAG implementations
  • Experience with freight, logistics, or supply chain systems and terminology
  • Knowledge of SQL and database queries for data analysis
  • Background in operations, RevOps, data engineering, or technical product roles
  • Experience measuring and optimizing automation ROI (cost per call, error rates, processing time)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and serverless architectures
  • Understanding of microservices architecture and event-driven systems


Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy AI-powered automation workflows using low-code platforms and custom JavaScript
  • Build intelligent systems that leverage large language models (LLMs) for decision-making, data extraction, and process automation
  • Create and maintain integrations between internal systems and third-party platforms using APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architectures
  • Develop data pipelines that transform, enrich, and route information across multiple systems and data sources
  • Implement prompt engineering strategies and design multi-step LLM orchestration workflows
  • Build and optimize automated workflows that eliminate repetitive manual tasks across operations teams
  • Monitor automation health, debug failures, and continuously optimize workflows for reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency
  • Identify new automation opportunities by collaborating directly with operations, product, and engineering teams
  • Document workflows, create runbooks, and establish best practices for scalable AI automation
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to shared automation libraries, frameworks, and templates
  • Measure and report on automation performance metrics, including accuracy, latency, cost savings, and operational impact
  • Prototype new AI capabilities and experiment with emerging technologies as part of our Technical Innovation Program
  • Example Projects & Initiatives To give you a sense of the types of challenges you'll tackle, here are examples of projects our AI Automation Engineers work on:
  • Intelligent Document Processing:
  • Build systems that automatically extract structured data from unstructured documents (PDFs, emails, images)
  • Create validation workflows that use AI to verify data accuracy and flag anomalies for human review
  • Design document classification systems that route different document types to appropriate processing pipelines
  • Implement OCR + LLM workflows that handle handwritten or poorly scanned documents
  • AI-Powered Business Process Automation:
  • Develop AI agents that conduct multi-step research and qualification processes autonomously
  • Build conversational systems that handle routine inquiries and escalate complex cases appropriately
  • Create intelligent routing and matching systems that optimize business outcomes using historical data and ML models
  • Design automated scheduling and coordination systems that handle complex business logic and constraints
  • System Integration & Data Orchestration:
  • Connect internal platforms with external third-party services, handling authentication, rate limiting, and error recovery
  • Build real-time data synchronization pipelines that keep multiple systems consistent
  • Create webhook listeners and event processors that trigger automated workflows based on external events
  • Design data enrichment pipelines that pull information from multiple sources and merge it intelligently
  • Operational Intelligence & Monitoring:
  • Build automated alerting and notification systems that detect anomalies and trigger appropriate responses
  • Create dashboards and reporting workflows that aggregate data from multiple sources
  • Develop predictive systems that use historical patterns to forecast operational needs
  • Design automated quality control systems that continuously validate data accuracy across systems
  • AI Innovation & Experimentation:
  • Prototype new AI capabilities using the latest LLM models and techniques
  • Experiment with vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation(RAG)
  • Build proof-of-concepts that demonstrate the business value of emerging AI technologies
  • Contribute to our Technical Innovation Program (TIP) with novel automation approaches
  • Platform & Infrastructure:
  • Develop reusable automation components, templates, and design patterns
  • Create internal tooling that makes it easier for other teams to build and deploy automations
  • Establish monitoring, logging, and observability standards for automation workflows
  • Build testing frameworks that ensure automation reliability and catch regressions
  • These projects span multiple teams and business functions - you'll have the opportunity to work on whatever creates the most business value, from carrier operations to customer experience to internal productivity tools.

title: Senior AI Automation Engineer
description:
Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience building integrations, automations, or workflow systems
  • Strong proficiency with low-code/no-code automation platforms (n8n,AI for business automation- Tray.ai, Zapier,Make | AI Workflow Automation Software & Tools ,or similar)
  • Solid JavaScript skills -most automation logic happens in JavaScript nodes and custom functions
  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar) and prompt engineering
  • Experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, JWT)
  • Understanding of data transformation and formats (JSON, XML, CSV)
  • Ability to read API documentation, debug integration issues, and troubleshoot automation failures
  • Experience building event-driven workflows and handling asynchronous processes
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Self-motivated, disciplined, and comfortable working independently across time zones
  • Great communication skills - ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Your English is at least at the Upper-Intermediate level to communicate with our teams
  • Preferred Skills/Abilities
  • Experience building AI agents or multi-step LLM workflows (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom implementations)
  • Python scripting for data processing, API integration, or ETL workflows
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools or iPaaS platforms (Temporal, Workato, MuleSoft)
  • Understanding of vector databases and semantic search for RAG implementations
  • Experience with freight, logistics, or supply chain systems and terminology
  • Knowledge of SQL and database queries for data analysis
  • Background in operations, RevOps, data engineering, or technical product roles
  • Experience measuring and optimizing automation ROI (cost per call, error rates, processing time)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and serverless architectures
  • Understanding of microservices architecture and event-driven systems


Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy AI-powered automation workflows using low-code platforms and custom JavaScript
  • Build intelligent systems that leverage large language models (LLMs) for decision-making, data extraction, and process automation
  • Create and maintain integrations between internal systems and third-party platforms using APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architectures
  • Develop data pipelines that transform, enrich, and route information across multiple systems and data sources
  • Implement prompt engineering strategies and design multi-step LLM orchestration workflows
  • Build and optimize automated workflows that eliminate repetitive manual tasks across operations teams
  • Monitor automation health, debug failures, and continuously optimize workflows for reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency
  • Identify new automation opportunities by collaborating directly with operations, product, and engineering teams
  • Document workflows, create runbooks, and establish best practices for scalable AI automation
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to shared automation libraries, frameworks, and templates
  • Measure and report on automation performance metrics, including accuracy, latency, cost savings, and operational impact
  • Prototype new AI capabilities and experiment with emerging technologies as part of our Technical Innovation Program
  • Example Projects & Initiatives To give you a sense of the types of challenges you'll tackle, here are examples of projects our AI Automation Engineers work on:
  • Intelligent Document Processing:
  • Build systems that automatically extract structured data from unstructured documents (PDFs, emails, images)
  • Create validation workflows that use AI to verify data accuracy and flag anomalies for human review
  • Design document classification systems that route different document types to appropriate processing pipelines
  • Implement OCR + LLM workflows that handle handwritten or poorly scanned documents
  • AI-Powered Business Process Automation:
  • Develop AI agents that conduct multi-step research and qualification processes autonomously
  • Build conversational systems that handle routine inquiries and escalate complex cases appropriately
  • Create intelligent routing and matching systems that optimize business outcomes using historical data and ML models
  • Design automated scheduling and coordination systems that handle complex business logic and constraints
  • System Integration & Data Orchestration:
  • Connect internal platforms with external third-party services, handling authentication, rate limiting, and error recovery
  • Build real-time data synchronization pipelines that keep multiple systems consistent
  • Create webhook listeners and event processors that trigger automated workflows based on external events
  • Design data enrichment pipelines that pull information from multiple sources and merge it intelligently
  • Operational Intelligence & Monitoring:
  • Build automated alerting and notification systems that detect anomalies and trigger appropriate responses
  • Create dashboards and reporting workflows that aggregate data from multiple sources
  • Develop predictive systems that use historical patterns to forecast operational needs
  • Design automated quality control systems that continuously validate data accuracy across systems
  • AI Innovation & Experimentation:
  • Prototype new AI capabilities using the latest LLM models and techniques
  • Experiment with vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation(RAG)
  • Build proof-of-concepts that demonstrate the business value of emerging AI technologies
  • Contribute to our Technical Innovation Program (TIP) with novel automation approaches
  • Platform & Infrastructure:
  • Develop reusable automation components, templates, and design patterns
  • Create internal tooling that makes it easier for other teams to build and deploy automations
  • Establish monitoring, logging, and observability standards for automation workflows
  • Build testing frameworks that ensure automation reliability and catch regressions
  • These projects span multiple teams and business functions - you'll have the opportunity to work on whatever creates the most business value, from carrier operations to customer experience to internal productivity tools.

title: Consultor SAP EWM
description:
Buscamos Consultor(a) SAP EWM sênior para atuar em projetos de implementação, rollouts e melhorias contínuas em grandes clientes, com foco em alta complexidade de processos de armazenagem em S/4HANA.


Qualificações:

• Formação superior completa em áreas de Tecnologia ou correlatas.

• Desejável pós-graduação e/ou certificação SAP.

• Necessários no mínimo 5 anos de atuação (que possam ser comprovados posteriormente).

• Ter sólida experiência em SAP Extended Warehouse Management, incluindo configuração de processos inbound/outbound, internal movements, estratégias de picking/putaway, inventário físico e integração com módulos MM, SD e TM.

• Forte atuação em desenho de soluções, condução de workshops com stakeholders de negócio, liderança de estimativas e planos de teste, além de elaboração de especificações funcionais.

Diferencial para experiência prévia em projetos internacionais, EWM embedded em S/4HANA e atuação próxima a times de desenvolvimento ABAP/Fiori.

A posição é 100% remota (CLT), em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador, com oportunidade de crescimento e exposição global.

title: Agencies BD & Recruited
description:
Corporate Information

TRANSSNET Group is a joint venture company established by China's leading Internet company NetEase Group (NASDAQ: NTES) and TRANSSION Holdings Group, a global provider of smart terminal products and mobile value-added services. TRANSSNET combines NetEase’s strong technical strength and advanced Internet product operation concepts with TRANSSION’s mature channel resources and solid market foundation in Africa, becoming one of the leading Internet companies serving the most users in Africa with excellent online applications from Boomplay, the largest online music platform in Africa, to TalkTalk and SOYO, both extraordinary social apps, to mobile games.


This position will serve the social app(SOYO) business unit.


Job Requirements:

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • At least one year of experience in agency recruitment or management of a social app.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to make friends with users.
  • Sales-oriented mindset with patience.
  • Enjoy using voice social apps, familiar with various features and gameplay.
  • Reliable and loyal, with integrity and a goal-oriented approach.


Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for recruiting agencies and hosts (at least 200-300 hosts per month)
  • Assist in the translation of events and product features (English to Portuguese)

title: Sênior de Auditoria Externa - Remoto
description:
Seja um #NewPurple na Grant Thornton Brasil!

O que esperar da Grant Thornton?

Valorizamos nossas pessoas e direcionamos todos os nossos esforços para a constante construção de uma cultura organizacional mais diversa e inclusiva. Somos apaixonados pelo sucesso das nossas equipes e alto desempenho junto a nossos clientes. Fazemos parte de uma rede global de 140 países. Por isso, temos o alcance e capacidade de direcionar sua carreira para onde você deseja ir.

Mantemos uma cultura de aprendizado e crescimento contínuo, encorajando nossos profissionais a aproveitar oportunidades e atingir todo o seu potencial. Temos um amplo programa de desenvolvimento de carreira adequado aos seus objetivos e às áreas de negócio da nossa empresa.

Aqui na Grant Thornton Brasil, temos espaço para todo mundo. Afinal, contamos com muitas outras cores por trás do nosso roxo!

Além disso, oferecemos ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e que atendem às necessidades pessoais e profissionais de nossos colaboradores, nesse processo, acreditamos que todos estarão mais engajados e energizados para desempenhar suas atividades, mantendo a qualidade de vida. Não é só sobre falar. É sobre agir!


Principais Responsabilidades/Atividades

  • Coordenar os trabalhos de auditoria, auxiliando e engajando o time;
  • Demonstrar adequado conhecimento de conceitos de auditoria, contabilidade e ferramentas utilizadas no trabalho de auditoria externa;
  • Adaptar os trabalhos às características e peculiaridades de cada cliente, criando um bom nível de relacionamento com eles.
  • Demonstrar conhecimentos em contabilidade e auditoria, impostos e tecnologia.
  • Demonstrar habilidade de planejamento, organização do trabalho e distribuição de tarefas para equipe;
  • Realizar a orientação e treinamento “on-the-job” dos Trainees e Associates;
  • Revisar os trabalhos de auditoria e gerenciar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Controlar e monitorar as horas para realização do trabalho, informando o gerente responsável.
  • Profissional atenderá projetos de clientes da divisão de indústria e serviços

Experiência Desejável

  • 3 anos em Auditoria

Formação Acadêmica

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando. Área de formação: Ciências Contábeis

Conhecimentos

  • Pacote Office
  • Matemática Financeira
  • Inglês Intermediário (Desejável)

Habilidades e Atitudes Desejáveis

  • Visão analítica / crítica
  • Organização
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal
  • Comprometimento
  • Confidencialidade
  • Pro atividade
  • Autodesenvolvimento

Valorizamos nossas pessoas e direcionamos todos os nossos esforços para a constante construção de uma cultura organizacional mais diversa e inclusiva. Somos apaixonados pelo sucesso das nossas equipes e alto desempenho junto a nossos clientes. Fazemos parte de uma rede global de 140 países. Por isso, temos o alcance e capacidade de direcionar sua carreira para onde você deseja ir.

Mantemos uma cultura de aprendizado e crescimento contínuo, encorajando nossos profissionais a aproveitar oportunidades e atingir todo o seu potencial. Temos um amplo programa de desenvolvimento de carreira adequado aos seus objetivos e às áreas de negócio da nossa empresa.

Aqui na Grant Thornton Brasil, temos espaço para todo mundo. Afinal, contamos com muitas outras cores por trás do nosso roxo!

Além disso, oferecemos ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e que atendem às necessidades pessoais e profissionais de nossos colaboradores, nesse processo, acreditamos que todos estarão mais engajados e energizados para desempenhar suas atividades, mantendo a qualidade de vida. Não é só sobre falar. É sobre agir!

  • Demonstrar habilidade de planejamento, organização do trabalho e distribuição de tarefas para equipe;
  • Realizar a orientação e treinamento “on-the-job” dos Trainees e Associates;

  • Controlar e monitorar as horas para realização do trabalho, informando o gerente responsável.
  • Profissional atenderá projetos de clientes da divisão de indústria e serviços

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Work Model :Remote

Location :Remote BR/Latam

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform . In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications, and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.


Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)

- Collaboration with other engineers working primarily in PST


Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir, java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Desenvolvedor Angular
description:
Sobre a FourD

A FourD atua apoiando seus clientes na concepção, implementação e evolução de produtos financeiros e jornadas digitais complexas, trabalhando em ambientes críticos, regulados e de alta escala. Atendemos grandes players como Nubank, Banco Next e Natura Pay, sempre com foco em qualidade, segurança e excelência técnica.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend Angular Sênior / Especialista, com forte maturidade técnica, para atuar como referência no time, contribuindo na definição de padrões, arquitetura frontend e evolução de aplicações financeiras.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações frontend em Angular (versões recentes), com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura frontend, padrões de componentização e boas práticas
  • Implementar interfaces responsivas, acessíveis e orientadas à experiência do usuário
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs REST em ambientes financeiros críticos
  • Lidar com fluxos complexos de negócio, validações e regras financeiras no frontend
  • Definir e garantir estratégias de testes automatizados (unitários e end-to-end)
  • Atuar como referência técnica em code reviews, promovendo qualidade e padronização
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança no frontend, observabilidade e performance
  • Documentar decisões técnicas, arquitetura e padrões adotados
  • Colaborar com times de produto, UX/UI, backend e QA


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com Angular (versões 12+)
  • Domínio de TypeScript, HTML5 e CSS3
  • Conhecimento avançado em RxJS, gerenciamento de estado e arquitetura frontend
  • Experiência com consumo de APIs REST
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de segurança frontend
  • Experiência com testes unitários (Jasmine, Karma ou similares)
  • Vivência com testes end-to-end (Cypress, Playwright ou similares)
  • Uso de Git e pipelines de CI/CD


Diferenciais

  • Vivência em fintechs, instituições bancárias ou empresas do setor financeiro
  • Experiência em projetos envolvendo crédito, onboarding, pagamentos, antifraude ou score de risco
  • Conhecimento em integrações com birôs de crédito e consumo de dados financeiros


Soft Skills

  • Forte senso de ownership e responsabilidade técnica
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e colaboração constante
  • Visão crítica, atenção a detalhes e foco em qualidade
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos e regulados


Modelo: Remoto | Contratação: PJ + Benefícios

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações frontend em Angular (versões recentes), com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura frontend, padrões de componentização e boas práticas
  • Implementar interfaces responsivas, acessíveis e orientadas à experiência do usuário
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs REST em ambientes financeiros críticos
  • Lidar com fluxos complexos de negócio, validações e regras financeiras no frontend
  • Definir e garantir estratégias de testes automatizados (unitários e end-to-end)
  • Atuar como referência técnica em code reviews, promovendo qualidade e padronização
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança no frontend, observabilidade e performance
  • Documentar decisões técnicas, arquitetura e padrões adotados
  • Colaborar com times de produto, UX/UI, backend e QA


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com Angular (versões 12+)
  • Domínio de TypeScript, HTML5 e CSS3
  • Conhecimento avançado em RxJS, gerenciamento de estado e arquitetura frontend
  • Experiência com consumo de APIs REST
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de segurança frontend
  • Experiência com testes unitários (Jasmine, Karma ou similares)
  • Vivência com testes end-to-end (Cypress, Playwright ou similares)
  • Uso de Git e pipelines de CI/CD


Diferenciais

  • Vivência em fintechs, instituições bancárias ou empresas do setor financeiro
  • Experiência em projetos envolvendo crédito, onboarding, pagamentos, antifraude ou score de risco
  • Conhecimento em integrações com birôs de crédito e consumo de dados financeiros


Soft Skills

  • Forte senso de ownership e responsabilidade técnica
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e colaboração constante
  • Visão crítica, atenção a detalhes e foco em qualidade
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos e regulados

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Remoto
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;

  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Recruiter
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.


Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


O ano de 2025 foi ótimo para nós, crescemos 155% e mais que dobramos nosso time de operações!


Buscamos novas pessoas para nosso time de recrutamento que queiram fazer parte desse crescimento acelerado:


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas


Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 4.500 – 12.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$6.500 - 9.000), sem teto.

title: Recrutador
description:
JR17643 Trilingual Recruiter (Portuguese, Spanish , English)- 12 months contract



We're a global leader in providing energy solutions that help businesses grow and communities thrive. We work as a team and we’re proud of the difference we make to customers, to local communities, and towards a sustainable future for the world.


We are hiring immediately a highly skilled recruiter to join our team – a role that is critical in making sure our company drive growth and be a consultant to the business.

Why Aggreko? Here are some of the perks and rewards.


· Work from home or in a local service center

· Competitive compensation

· Year-end bonus potential

· No premium cost medical plan option available

· Paid training programs and tuition reimbursement.

· Safety-focused culture

What you'll do:


  • Manage and lead complex recruitment projects, focusing on high impact hiring for specialized and senior roles
  • Use talent intelligence tools (e.g., TalentNeuron) and external data to provide market insights and strategic advice for hiring managers
  • Optimize recruitment processes through data-driven decisions, identifying efficiency improvements and continuous enhancements
  • Collaborate with HR, business leaders, and employer branding teams to boost talent acquisition effectiveness.
  • Mentor and influence the recruitment of team members by leading through example and addressing hiring challenges proactively
  • Develop proactive hiring strategies informed by market trends, industry layoffs, competitor activities, and regulatory changes
  • Key performance indicators include managing seamless hiring processes, leveraging data for sourcing strategies, and leading process improvements
  • Recognized as a trusted advisor to stakeholders and actively foster a culture of mentorship and strategic problem-solving within the team




We’re experts, which means you’ll have the following skills and experience:


  • Manage and lead complex recruitment projects, focusing on high impact hiring for specialized and senior roles
  • Use talent intelligence tools (e.g., TalentNeuron) and external data to provide market insights and strategic advice for hiring managers
  • Optimize recruitment processes through data-driven decisions, identifying efficiency improvements and continuous enhancements
  • Collaborate with HR, business leaders, and employer branding teams to boost talent acquisition effectiveness.
  • Mentor and influence the recruitment of team members by leading through example and addressing hiring challenges proactively
  • Develop proactive hiring strategies informed by market trends, industry layoffs, competitor activities, and regulatory changes
  • Key performance indicators include managing seamless hiring processes, leveraging data for sourcing strategies, and leading process improvements
  • Recognized as a trusted advisor to stakeholders and actively foster a culture of mentorship and strategic problem-solving within the team
  • Trilingual ( Portuguese, Spanish and English)



We recruit the best talent. Apply now and help us keep the power on.

title: Agencies BD for social APP
description:
Corporate Information

TRANSSNET Group is a joint venture company established by China's leading Internet company NetEase Group (NASDAQ: NTES) and TRANSSION Holdings Group, a global provider of smart terminal products and mobile value-added services. TRANSSNET combines NetEase’s strong technical strength and advanced Internet product operation concepts with TRANSSION’s mature channel resources and solid market foundation in Africa, becoming one of the leading Internet companies serving the most users in Africa with excellent online applications from Boomplay, the largest online music platform in Africa, to TalkTalk and SOYO, both extraordinary social apps, to mobile games.


This position will serve the social app(SOYO/SOYOU) business unit.


Job Requirements:

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • Independently recruit and manage agencies (at least 200-300 hosts per month)，hosts,and coin-dealers .
  • Resource Acquisition: Engage with and recruit high-value resources, and ensure their maintenance.
  • Strategy Development: Formulate and execute recruitment strategies, with accountability for results.


Salary：basic+KPI+bonus

title: Application Support Developer (Java / MySQL)
description:
We are looking for an Application Support Developer with strong experience in Java and MySQL to support and enhance our client's application system, on the transportation product line.

The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Portal & Server Management: Troubleshoot portal server errors, monitor AWS logs, and ensure report delivery.
  • ETL & Data Operations: Manage ETL file uploads, monitor ongoing/completed loads, and resolve missing data issues.
  • Reporting (JasperReports): Maintain and enhance custom reports, add/remove columns and filters, manage run tickets, and troubleshoot disappearing reports.
  • Database Management (MySQL): Perform schema updates, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity for reporting and ETL processes.
  • Integrations: Support Samsara, Geotab, and Motive integrations and data imports.
  • Environment Management: Handle migrations between Alpha, Beta, and Production environments.
  • Bulk Updates: Execute mass-scale changes (Tank ID, Lease Name, Account, Terminal details) and perform data cleanup.


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience using Java and MySQL
  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with JasperReports
  • Prior experience using React.js


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Software Engineer - C#
description:
About the Company

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer, based of Argentina or Brazil, with a strong specialization in C#, software development methodologies and the ability to design, develop and maintain complex .NET / C# based applications, while also contributing significantly to the technical excellence of the team.


Responsibilities

  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Develop strategies for transitioning from legacy systems to modern architectures.
  • Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience as backend developer with a strong focus on C#.
  • Proficient in .NET Framework/.NET Core.
  • Can design RESTful APIs, architect software systems (taking into consideration scalability, maintainability and performance).
  • Emphasizes the importance of testing, automated testing frameworks and writing unit tests.
  • Strong knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL).
  • Familiar with design patterns, microservices, event driven architecture and other software design principles.
  • Familiar with DevOps practices (CI, CD and deployments pipelines). Utilizes tools like Git, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure or Google Cloud for development and deployment.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies (e.g., React, Angular) is a plus.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Fully remote position, with the opportunity to travel to the US.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • The chance to work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technologies.

title: Analista de Negócio de Tecnologia
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de Negócio de Tecnologia



Resumo:

Estamos em busca de um profissional com profundo conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, experiência comprovada na coleta de requisitos e atuação como Scrum Master, além de um backgroud em desenvolvimento de sistemas. O candidato ideal deve demonstrar habilidades em liderança de projetos e ser capaz de atuar como facilitador de equipes ágeis, assegurando a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.



Atribuições :


  • Liderar projetos: Coordenar equipes e garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Auxiliar na definição e levantamento de requisitos: Elaborar e documentar histórias de usuário, assegurando que estejam claras, completas e alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio.
  • Elaborar e monitorar status reports: Acompanhar KPIs e métricas de desempenho dos projetos, fornecendo informações precisas sobre o progresso e as áreas de melhoria.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico ao time de desenvolvimento: Ajudar na resolução de problemas técnicos, apoiar a tomada de decisões e facilitar a comunicação eficaz entre os membros da equipe.
  • Colaborar com diversas áreas interdependentes: Trabalhar com diferentes equipes e stakeholders, tanto dentro quanto fora do departamento de TI, para garantir que os projetos atendam às expectativas e requisitos das partes interessadas.
  • Atuar como Scrum Master: Facilitar a execução das reuniões e eventos ágeis, promovendo a adoção das melhores práticas e garantindo a eficiência dos processos ágeis.
  • Prestar consultoria e suporte aos clientes internos: Orientar sobre as regras de negócio dos sistemas em utilização e assegurar que as soluções atendam às suas necessidades.



Requisitos :

* Experiência mínima de 6 anos como Scrum Master ou analista de desenvolvimento, com atuação em levantamento de requisitos.

* Formação superior completa ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas de tecnologia.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Experiência prévia como Scrum Master ou em um papel similar de liderança de projetos ágeis;
  • Sólido conhecimento e experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas;
  • Experiência em liderança e gestão de projetos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão ágil, como Azure DevOps ou Jira.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Conhecimento em Linux;
  • Conhecimento na plataforma Azure (provisionamento, acesso e gerenciamento de recursos);
  • Conhecimento de práticas DevOps (containers, integração e deploy contínuo);
  • Certificação de SCRUM Master.



Idiomas:

  • Inglês avançado fundamental;
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.
